scope: AST inventory of listener calls, generated HTML handler literals, prompt/preference/choice callbacks, timer calls and selected autonomous entry points in the eight pinned source files.
caveats: Region mappings identify an implementation family, not verified callback equivalence.
Dynamic string concatenation, handler generation and browser layout require separate runtime evidence.
The policy action set combines UI events and guarded API operations. It neither enumerates all UI histories nor proves every API operation equivalent to one physical input.
The policy action set is still a reviewed subset; partial or unresolved entries must not be silently excluded from an optimality theorem.

actionModelBoundary.scope: Limits of this executable adapter, not restrictions proved sufficient for all-strategy comparison.

buildingPurchases.nativeUiMax: There is no buy-Max control. Selecting All in buy mode changes the quantity to100; All is visible only in sell mode.
buildingPurchases.guardedApiAffordability: buy-building requires the full getSumPrice quote. The native buy loop can still purchase fewer copies because it debits each rounded getPrice separately.
buildingPurchases.quoteVsDebit: getSumPrice rounds once after the raw sum and discounts. buy(amount) rounds and debits each copy. The quote is not an exact acquisition-cost certificate.
buildingPurchases.equivalenceLimit: Several smaller batches invoke sound and refresh callbacks more often and permit interleavings. No event-history equivalence is claimed.

buildingSales.guardedApiAmountRange: Positive safe integers up to the current holding.

otherLimits: market-buy and market-sell accept1..10000; native10000 is the Max/All sentinel, not a fixed numerical quantity.
resize accepts width200..16384 and height100..16384; these are adapter resource limits, not a native maximum screen size.
The policy sequence macro permits at most1000 inputs. It does not skip callbacks or infer an admissible infinite input sequence.
Explicit cookie-pointer phases preserve the mapped native handlers; general pointer paths, capture, focus and drag semantics remain partial.

tooltip-pointer supports native control IDs and statistics crates by type/data-id, dispatches existing handlers, and rejects selected CSS-hidden or covered controls. Anonymous non-crate targets and complete CSS hit testing remain partial.

maintenanceReloads.authorizedClass: Scheduled maintenance reloads are allowed; random-outcome retries remain forbidden.
maintenanceReloads.adapterSubclass: An immutable list of elapsed-ms requests or fixed-period schedule is selected before new-save startup. Lifecycle guards defer requests; overlapping requests coalesce. The policy cannot trigger a reload, supply a save, or alter the schedule after startup.
maintenanceReloads.nativePath: Visible Options → Change language → English; native Logic waits for minigame loading and save completion before App.reload. A fresh VM/DOM/timer queue then executes the pinned startup and native delayed LoadSave.
maintenanceReloads.preservedState: Only the current native serialized save, localStorage, elapsed clock and continuing free-draw stream cross navigation. Native serialization and load determine quantization, buff reconstruction, discarded shimmers and timer restart.
maintenanceReloads.exportInteraction: ExportSave clears toSave without persisting. Export remains available after a maintenance request, but a subsequent native reload without an App.save after that request is an inadmissible rollback trace, not a native game failure. The native Ctrl+S input can restore the save request before navigation.
maintenanceReloads.limitation: This implements a scheduled subclass. It does not prove equivalence to every allowed maintenance policy or a full browser navigation refinement.

actionModelBoundary.informationBoundary: The policy receives public observations and their history, including the current native Export save textarea when opened through the Options anchor. Its encoded startup seed may be decoded under the user-approved rule. Direct private state, experiment RNG state and future draws are not exposed. The user allows scheduled current-save maintenance reloads and forbids import, save editing, outcome retries and deliberate native-UI manipulation of random outcomes.
